title: ANÁLISIS DE PRODUCTO
purpose: Utiliza este prompt para comprender en profundidad un producto o servicio antes de desarrollar una estrategia de marketing, escribir un guion, crear una campaña publicitaria o generar contenido con Inteligencia Artificial. Este análisis te permitirá identificar oportunidades de venta, ventajas competitivas y conocer mejor a tu cliente ideal.
variables: [PRODUCT] → Nombre del producto o servicio que deseas analizar.
prompt:
Act as a senior marketing strategist and consumer behavior expert.
Analyze the following product or service:
Product: [PRODUCT]
Your objective is to generate a comprehensive marketing analysis that can be used as the foundation for advertising campaigns, content creation, and sales strategies.
Identify and explain:
- The main problems the product solves
- Functional benefits
- Emotional benefits
- Unique selling points (USP)
- Key competitive advantages
- Target audience profile
- Purchase motivations
- Common buying objections
- Potential market opportunities
- Suggested positioning strategy
Present the results in a clear, well-organized table with actionable insights.

title: AVATAR DEL CLIENTE IDEAL
purpose: Este prompt permite construir un perfil detallado del cliente ideal. Es recomendable utilizarlo después del análisis de producto para conocer mejor a quién va dirigido el contenido y facilitar la creación de campañas publicitarias más efectivas.
prompt:
Act as a customer research specialist and consumer behavior expert.
Based on the following product or service:
Product: [PRODUCT]
Create a detailed customer avatar.
Include:
- Name
- Age range
- Gender
- Occupation
- Income level
- Education
- Interests
- Lifestyle
- Values
- Goals
- Pain points
- Desires
- Frustrations
- Buying motivations
- Buying objections
- Preferred social media platforms
- Online behavior
- Preferred communication style
- Purchasing habits
Present the information in a structured profile that can be used for marketing and advertising campaigns.

title: DOLORES DEL CLIENTE
purpose: Identificar los principales problemas, frustraciones y necesidades del cliente ideal. Estos dolores serán la base para construir anuncios, guiones, ofertas y mensajes publicitarios que conecten emocionalmente con la audiencia.
prompt:
Act as a market research expert and consumer psychologist.
Analyze the target audience for the following product: [PRODUCT]
Generate the 15 most significant pain points experienced by the ideal customer.
For each pain point include:
- Pain Point
- Why it matters
- Emotional impact
- How the product helps solve it
Present the results in a table ranked from most important to least important.

title: DESEOS DEL CLIENTE
purpose: Descubrir las aspiraciones, objetivos y resultados que el cliente realmente desea alcanzar. Este prompt ayuda a construir mensajes que venden transformación y no solo características del producto.
prompt:
Act as a consumer behavior specialist for the following product: [PRODUCT]
Identify the top 15 desires of the ideal customer.
For each desire explain:
- Desired outcome
- Emotional motivation
- Why it is important
- How the product fulfills that desire
Rank them from highest to lowest priority.

title: MIEDOS DEL CLIENTE
purpose: Identificar los temores y preocupaciones que pueden impedir la compra. Con esta información podrás crear mensajes que reduzcan objeciones y generen mayor confianza.
prompt:
Act as a consumer psychology expert and analyze the target audience for:
Product: [PRODUCT]
Identify the 15 biggest fears related to purchasing or using this type of product.
For each fear explain:
- The fear
- The underlying cause
- Emotional impact
- How the brand can reduce or eliminate it
Present the information in a structured table.

title: ASPIRACIONES DEL CLIENTE
purpose: Este prompt permite descubrir las metas, sueños y aspiraciones del cliente ideal. Es especialmente útil para crear campañas publicitarias que vendan una transformación o un estilo de vida, en lugar de simplemente promocionar un producto.
prompt:
Act as a consumer insights specialist and behavioral psychologist.
Analyze the ideal customer for the following product or service:
Product: [PRODUCT]
Identify the top 15 aspirations of the target audience.
For each aspiration provide:
- Aspiration
- Why it matters
- Emotional driver
- Desired transformation
- How the product helps achieve that aspiration
Rank the aspirations from highest to lowest emotional impact.
Present the information in a structured table with actionable marketing insights.

title: ANÁLISIS DE LA COMPETENCIA
purpose: Analizar a los principales competidores para identificar oportunidades de diferenciación, detectar fortalezas y debilidades del mercado y construir una propuesta de valor más competitiva.
prompt:
Act as a senior competitive intelligence analyst and analyze the competitive landscape for the following product or service:
Product: [PRODUCT]
Identify the main competitors and provide the following analysis:
- Competitor Name
- Strengths
- Weaknesses
- Pricing Strategy
- Brand Positioning
- Marketing Style
- Target Audience
- Content Strategy
- Unique Selling Points
Finally, recommend:
- Market opportunities
- Competitive advantages to emphasize
- Ways to differentiate the brand
- Untapped positioning opportunities
Present the results in a structured comparison table.

title: PROPUESTA ÚNICA DE VALOR (USP)
purpose: Generar propuestas únicas de valor que permitan diferenciar el producto frente a la competencia y comunicar claramente por qué un cliente debería elegirlo.
prompt:
Act as a senior brand strategist and positioning expert and based on the following product or service: Product: [PRODUCT]
Generate 10 unique selling propositions (USPs).
Each USP should include:
- Headline
- Core Value Proposition
- Emotional Benefit
- Functional Benefit
- Target Customer
- Competitive Advantage
The propositions should be persuasive, memorable, and suitable for modern digital marketing campaigns.

title: GENERADOR DE OFERTA IRRESISTIBLE
purpose: Construir una oferta de alto valor percibido que aumente la intención de compra mediante una combinación de beneficios, bonos, garantías y elementos de urgencia.
prompt:

Target Audience: [TARGET AUDIENCE]

- Bonus #2
- Bonus #3

Present the offer in a persuasive format suitable for landing pages, sales videos, and advertising campaigns.

title: Estrategia de Marketing
purpose: Diseñar una estrategia de marketing integral antes de comenzar la producción de contenido. Este prompt ayuda a definir objetivos, canales, mensajes clave y acciones recomendadas para una campaña.
variables: [OBJECTIVE] → Objetivo principal de la campaña (ventas, generación de leads, reconocimiento de marca, lanzamiento, etc.).
prompt:
Act as a Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) with expertise in digital marketing, branding, and AI-driven content strategies and develop a complete marketing strategy for the following product or service:
Product: [PRODUCT]
Target Audience: [TARGET AUDIENCE]
Campaign Objective: [OBJECTIVE]
Include:
- Brand Positioning

- Customer Persona Summary
- Key Messaging
- Content Pillars
- Recommended Marketing Channels
- Social Media Strategy
- Advertising Strategy
- Content Funnel
- Suggested KPIs
- Recommended AI Content Types
- Action Plan for the First 30 Days
Present the strategy in a professional report with clear recommendations.
CAPÍTULO 2
Storytelling

title: GENERADOR DE STORYTELLING
purpose: Este prompt permite crear una historia comercial utilizando una estructura narrativa diseñada para captar la atención, conectar emocionalmente con la audiencia y conducir naturalmente hacia una llamada a la acción.
prompt:
Act as an award-winning advertising copywriter and storytelling expert and create a compelling story for the following product or service.
Product: [PRODUCT]
Target Audience: [TARGET AUDIENCE]
Format: [TikTok / Instagram Reel / Commercial Spot / YouTube Video]
Duration: [DURATION]
Follow this storytelling framework:
1. Hook – Capture attention within the first 3 seconds.
2. Problem – Introduce a relatable pain point.
3. Solution – Present the product naturally as the solution.
4. Transformation – Show the emotional and practical benefits.
5. Call to Action – End with a persuasive CTA.
Creative Guidelines:
- Keep the story emotionally engaging.
- Focus on transformation rather than product features.
- Use natural and conversational language.
- Make the story memorable and authentic.
- Optimize pacing for short-form content.
Output the story scene by scene.

title: HISTORIA EMOCIONAL
purpose: Crear historias cuyo principal objetivo sea despertar emociones y generar una conexión profunda con la audiencia.
variables: [EMOTION] → Hope, Joy, Trust, Nostalgia, Inspiration, etc.
prompt:
Act as a master storyteller specializing in emotional advertising and create an emotionally powerful story for:
Product: [PRODUCT]
Target Audience: [TARGET AUDIENCE]
Primary Emotion: [EMOTION]
The story should:
- Capture attention immediately.
- Build empathy.
- Create emotional tension.
- Deliver a meaningful transformation.
- End with hope and inspiration.
Write the story scene by scene using cinematic language.

title: Generador de Storyboard
purpose: Convierte un guion en un storyboard profesional, organizando la historia en escenas claramente definidas. Este prompt es ideal antes de comenzar la generación de imágenes con IA.
variables: [SCRIPT] → Guion completo que se convertirá en storyboard. (Lo generado con el prompt de guiones y puedes cargarlo como un Word o PDF. Para obtenerlo, puedes pedirle que te entregue el guión en PDF o Word luego de haberlo generado)
prompt:
Act as a professional film director and storyboard artist.
Convert the following script into a detailed production storyboard.
Script: [SCRIPT]
For each scene provide:
- Scene Number
- Scene Title
- Scene Duration
- Visual Description
- Camera Shot
- Camera Angle
- Camera Movement
- Character Action
- Environment
- Emotional Objective
- Lighting Style
Present the storyboard in a structured table that can be used directly for AI image generation.

title: Desglose de Escenas

variables: [SCRIPT] → Guion completo. (Lo generado con el prompt de guiones y puedes cargarlo como un Word o PDF. Para obtenerlo, puedes pedirle que te entregue el guión en PDF o Word luego de haberlo generado)
prompt:

Keep the descriptions concise and production-ready.

title: Lista de Planos (Shot List)

variables: [SCRIPT] → Guion del proyecto. (Lo generado con el prompt de guiones y puedes cargarlo como un Word o PDF. Para obtenerlo, puedes pedirle que te entregue el guión en PDF o Word luego de haberlo generado)

Organize the shots in production order.

title: Prompts Visuales por Escena

variables: [STORYBOARD] → Storyboard generado previamente. (Lo generado con el prompt de storyboard y puedes cargarlo como un Word o PDF. Para obtenerlo, puedes pedirle que te entregue el storyboard en PDF o Word luego de haberlo generado)

- Mood
- Color Palette
- Cinematic Style
- Level of Detail
The prompts must be optimized for photorealistic AI image generation and maintain visual consistency across all scenes.

variables: [SCRIPT] → Guion completo. (Lo generado con el prompt de guiones y puedes cargarlo como un Word o PDF. Para obtenerlo, puedes pedirle que te entregue el guión en PDF o Word luego de haberlo generado)

CAPÍTULO 5
Consistencia de Personajes

title: Character Sheet (Ficha Maestra del Personaje)
purpose: Crear la ficha maestra de un personaje. Este prompt será la base para mantener una apariencia consistente durante toda la producción de imágenes y videos.
prompt:
Act as a senior character designer and AI visual development artist. Create a master character reference sheet for the following character.
Character Name: [CHARACTER NAME]
Age: [AGE]
Gender: [GENDER]
Ethnicity: [ETHNICITY]
Physical Appearance: [DESCRIPTION]
Hairstyle: [HAIRSTYLE]
Eye Color: [EYE COLOR]
Body Type: [BODY TYPE]
Wardrobe Style: [WARDROBE]
Accessories: [ACCESSORIES]
Expression: [DEFAULT EXPRESSION]
Generate a highly detailed front-facing studio character sheet.
Requirements:
- White seamless background
- Neutral pose
- Full body
- Front view
- Consistent proportions
- Natural lighting
- Ultra photorealistic
- Commercial quality
- Maximum facial detail
This image will serve as the master reference for all future AI-generated scenes.

title: Character Lock
purpose: Bloquear la identidad visual del personaje para evitar que cambie entre imágenes.
prompt:
Use the uploaded character reference image as the definitive identity.
Maintain exactly the same:
- Face
- Facial proportions
- Skin tone
- Hair
- Hairstyle
- Eye color
- Body proportions
- Age
- Ethnicity
- Identity
Do not modify or reinterpret the character.
Only change the environment, clothing, pose, facial expression or action when explicitly requested.
Character consistency is the highest priority.

title: Cambio de Vestuario
purpose: Cambiar únicamente la ropa del personaje sin modificar su identidad.
prompt:
Use the uploaded character reference as the definitive identity.
Keep exactly the same:
- Face
- Hairstyle
- Skin tone
- Body proportions
- Identity
Only replace the outfit with: [NEW OUTFIT]
Maintain the same level of realism, lighting and character consistency.
Do not alter facial features or body shape.

title: Cambio de Expresión y Pose
purpose: Modificar únicamente la expresión facial y la postura del personaje.
prompt:
Use the uploaded character reference as the definitive identity.
Maintain:
- Face
- Hair
- Identity
- Clothing
Only modify:
Expression: [EXPRESSION]
Pose: [POSE]
Ensure natural body language and realistic facial expressions.
Do not modify any other aspect of the character.

title: Personaje en Nuevos Escenarios
purpose: Ubicar al mismo personaje en diferentes escenarios sin perder consistencia.
prompt:
Use the uploaded character reference as the definitive identity.
Maintain complete facial and body consistency.
Place the character in: [LOCATION]
The character is performing: [ACTION]
Maintain:
- Identity
- Body proportions
- Face
- Hair
- Clothing
Adapt only the environment and lighting.
Create a cinematic, ultra-photorealistic scene with professional composition.

title: Hoja Completa de Consistencia del Personaje
purpose: Generar una ficha técnica completa que pueda utilizarse durante todo un proyecto audiovisual para mantener la coherencia del personaje.
prompt:
Act as a senior AI character supervisor.
Create a complete character consistency sheet.
Character: [CHARACTER DESCRIPTION]
Generate the following sections:
- Physical Description
- Face Description
- Hair Description
- Skin Tone
- Body Type
- Height
- Clothing Style
- Accessories
- Personality Traits
- Typical Facial Expressions
- Color Palette
- Lighting Recommendations
- Camera Recommendations
- Negative Prompt Suggestions
- Consistency Rules
The document should serve as the official visual guide for maintaining character consistency throughout an AI production.
CAPÍTULO 6
Consistencia de Productos

- Front view
- Side view
- Rear view

- Bottom view
- 45-degree perspective view
- Ultra photorealistic
- Commercial studio lighting
- High detail

title: Product Lock
purpose: Bloquear la identidad visual del producto para evitar cambios involuntarios en su forma, materiales o detalles durante la generación de nuevas imágenes.
prompt:
Use the uploaded product reference image as the definitive master reference.
Maintain exactly the same:
- Shape
- Dimensions
- Materials
- Colors
- Surface finish
- Logo placement
- Labels
- Textures
- Proportions
- Branding
Do not redesign, reinterpret or modify the product.
Only change the environment, lighting, camera angle or composition when explicitly requested.
Product consistency is the highest priority.

title: Cambio de Color del Producto
purpose: Modificar únicamente el color del producto sin alterar ninguna otra característica física.
prompt:
Use the uploaded product reference as the definitive master reference.
Maintain exactly the same:
- Shape
- Dimensions
- Materials
- Branding
- Labels
- Finish
- Details
Only replace the primary color with: [NEW COLOR]
Keep every other element identical.
Maintain photorealistic quality and studio lighting.

title: Cambio de Material o Acabado
purpose: Cambiar el material o el acabado superficial del producto conservando su diseño original.
prompt:
Use the uploaded product reference as the definitive master reference.
Maintain:
- Shape
- Dimensions
- Logo
- Colors
- Branding
Only replace the material or surface finish with: [NEW MATERIAL]
Examples:
- Brushed aluminum

LA REGLA DEL CAPÍTULO
Un error muy común al generar video con IA es pedir: "Haz un movimiento de cámara cinematográfico."
Eso deja demasiadas decisiones al modelo.
Un director piensa diferente:
¿Desde dónde empieza la cámara?
↓
¿Hacia dónde se mueve?
↓
¿A qué velocidad?
↓
¿Qué está revelando?
↓
¿Por qué ese movimiento ayuda a contar la historia?
Por eso, el objetivo del capítulo no es memorizar 10 movimientos.
Es aprender a utilizar la cámara como una herramienta narrativa.
Fórmula práctica:
SUJETO + ACCIÓN + MOVIMIENTO + DIRECCIÓN + VELOCIDAD + PROPÓSITO

Compose an original cinematic score for:
Scene: [SCENE]
Story Context: [STORY CONTEXT]
Emotion: [EMOTION]
Genre: [GENRE]
Duration: [DURATION]
Create an evolving musical composition that follows the emotional arc of the scene.
Structure the music around:
- Emotional Introduction
- Tension or Development
- Rising Intensity
- Emotional Peak
- Resolution
Use cinematic instrumentation, dynamic orchestration, atmospheric textures and carefully controlled intensity.
The music should enhance the story without overpowering the visuals.

title: Música para UGC
chapter_title: MÚSICA Y DISEÑO MUSICAL CON IA
purpose: Crear música de fondo para contenido UGC, Reels y TikToks sin hacer que el contenido parezca un comercial tradicional.
prompt:
Act as a social media music producer.
Create an original background track for a UGC-style video.
Topic: [TOPIC]
Target Audience: [TARGET AUDIENCE]
Platform: [PLATFORM]
Mood: [MOOD]
Genre: [GENRE]
Duration: [DURATION]
The music should feel modern, natural and social-media friendly.
Keep the arrangement simple and leave enough space for dialogue and voice-over.
Use a memorable but subtle musical hook.
Avoid excessive cinematic orchestration or overly dramatic elements.
The final track should support the content without distracting from the speaker.

title: Música de Marca
chapter_title: MÚSICA Y DISEÑO MUSICAL CON IA
purpose: Crear una identidad sonora coherente para una marca. Este prompt es especialmente útil cuando queremos que una empresa no solamente se vea reconocible, sino también suene reconocible.
prompt:
Act as a sonic branding strategist and professional music producer.
Develop a distinctive musical identity for:
Brand: [BRAND]
Industry: [INDUSTRY]
Brand Personality: [BRAND PERSONALITY]
Target Audience: [TARGET AUDIENCE]
Core Values: [CORE VALUES]
Desired Emotional Association: [EMOTION]
Create a sonic direction including:
- Musical Genre
- Tempo
- Instrumentation
- Sonic Texture
- Energy
- Emotional Character
- Signature Musical Elements
The sound should be recognizable, memorable and aligned with the brand personality.
Avoid generic corporate music.

title: Música Emocional
chapter_title: MÚSICA Y DISEÑO MUSICAL CON IA
purpose: Diseñar música específicamente alrededor de una emoción determinada. Ideal para storytelling, testimoniales, campañas sociales y contenido inspiracional.
prompt:
Act as an emotional film composer.
Create an original music track designed to evoke: [EMOTION]
Project: [PROJECT]
Story: [STORY]
Duration: [DURATION]
Use musical elements that reinforce the emotional experience.
Consider:
- Tempo
- Harmony
- Instrumentation
- Dynamics
- Musical Tension
- Release
- Silence
- Emotional Build
The composition should gradually intensify the intended emotion without becoming melodramatic.
Create a sophisticated and emotionally authentic soundtrack.

title: Música Épica
chapter_title: MÚSICA Y DISEÑO MUSICAL CON IA
purpose: Crear música de alto impacto para trailers, lanzamientos, automóviles, deportes, tecnología y contenidos que necesitan sensación de poder y grandeza.
prompt:
Act as a professional trailer music composer.
Create a powerful epic soundtrack for:
Project: [PROJECT]
Visual Concept: [VISUAL CONCEPT]
Desired Emotion:[EMOTION]
Duration: [DURATION]
Create a progressive musical build featuring:
- Atmospheric Introduction
- Rhythmic Development
- Increasing Tension
- Powerful Percussion
- Cinematic Impact
- Emotional Climax
- Strong Final Resolution
Use orchestral elements, cinematic percussion, deep low frequencies and dramatic dynamics.
The music should feel powerful, modern and cinematic without becoming generic or repetitive.

title: Música Adaptada a una Edición
chapter_title: MÚSICA Y DISEÑO MUSICAL CON IA
purpose: Este es uno de los prompts más útiles para el flujo profesional. En lugar de crear música primero y luego intentar adaptar el video a ella, podemos analizar la edición y diseñar la música alrededor del montaje.
prompt:
Act as a professional film editor and music supervisor.
Analyze the following video structure: [VIDEO STRUCTURE]
Video Duration: [DURATION]
Scene Breakdown: [SCENE BREAKDOWN]
Create a music direction that synchronizes with the visual rhythm.
Identify:
- Opening Musical Cue
- Scene Transitions
- Energy Changes
- Emotional Moments
- Musical Accents
- Climax
- Ending
Recommend:
- Tempo
- Genre
- Instrumentation
- Energy Curve
- Musical Structure
- Key Transition Points
The music should support the pacing and emotional progression of the edit.
Create a detailed music-generation prompt based on this analysis.

title: Prompt Maestro de Voice Over
chapter_title: VOZ Y DIRECCIÓN DE VOZ CON IA
purpose: Crear una dirección profesional de voz para acompañar un video, definiendo quién habla, cómo habla y qué debe transmitir.
prompt:
Act as a professional voice director and commercial script supervisor.
Create a detailed voice-over direction for:
Project: [PROJECT]
Script: [SCRIPT]
Target Audience: [TARGET AUDIENCE]
Voice Type: [VOICE TYPE]
Age: [AGE]
Tone: [TONE]
Emotion: [EMOTION]
Pacing: [PACING]
The voice should communicate the intended message naturally and convincingly.
Define:
- Vocal Tone
- Emotional Intensity
- Speaking Speed
- Pausing
- Emphasis
- Pronunciation
- Energy
- Emotional Progression
The performance should sound natural, professional and emotionally connected to the audience.
Avoid robotic delivery, excessive exaggeration and unnatural pauses.

title: Voice Over Comercial
chapter_title: VOZ Y DIRECCIÓN DE VOZ CON IA
purpose: Crear una voz publicitaria persuasiva para anuncios de productos, servicios y campañas.
prompt:
Act as a professional advertising voice director.
Create a commercial voice-over performance for:
Brand: [BRAND]
Product: [PRODUCT]
Script: [SCRIPT]
Target Audience: [TARGET AUDIENCE]
Brand Personality: [BRAND PERSONALITY]
Desired Emotion: [EMOTION]
The voice should sound:
- Confident
- Natural
- Persuasive
- Clear
- Professional
- Emotionally engaging
Use strategic pauses and emphasis on the most important words.
The performance should sell the idea without sounding aggressive or overly promotional.
End with a confident and memorable delivery of the call to action.

title: Voz UGC
chapter_title: VOZ Y DIRECCIÓN DE VOZ CON IA
purpose: Crear una voz que parezca la de una persona real recomendando un producto, evitando el típico tono de anuncio.
prompt:
Act as a professional UGC voice director.
Create a natural conversational voice performance.
Character: [CHARACTER]
Product: [PRODUCT]
Script: [SCRIPT]
Relationship with the Audience: [RELATIONSHIP]
Emotion: [EMOTION]
The voice should sound spontaneous, relatable and authentic.
Use:
- Natural conversational rhythm
- Small variations in pitch
- Realistic pauses
- Subtle emotional reactions
- Natural emphasis
- Human imperfections
Avoid sounding like a traditional commercial narrator.
The performance should feel like a real person genuinely sharing their experience with the audience.

title: Voz Cinematográfica
chapter_title: VOZ Y DIRECCIÓN DE VOZ CON IA
purpose: Crear una narración profunda y emocional para storytelling, documentales, trailers y videos cinematográficos.
prompt:
Act as a professional cinematic voice director.
Create a cinematic narration for:
Story: [STORY]
Script: [SCRIPT]
Narrator: [NARRATOR DESCRIPTION]
Emotion: [EMOTION]
Pacing: [PACING]
The narrator should have a distinctive and emotionally immersive presence.
Use controlled vocal dynamics, intentional pauses, subtle changes in intensity and carefully emphasized words.
The performance should gradually evolve with the story.
Start with: [OPENING EMOTION]
Build toward: [EMOTIONAL CLIMAX]
End with: [ENDING EMOTION]
Avoid excessive theatricality.
The narration should feel authentic, powerful and cinematic.

title: Dirección de Emoción Vocal
chapter_title: VOZ Y DIRECCIÓN DE VOZ CON IA
purpose: Dirigir la interpretación de una misma frase para conseguir una emoción específica. Es especialmente útil cuando una voz técnicamente correcta no transmite nada.
prompt:
Act as an expert voice acting coach.
Analyze the following line: [LINE]
Desired Emotion: [EMOTION]
Context: [CONTEXT]
Provide detailed performance direction.
Explain how the actor should control:
- Tone
- Pitch
- Volume
- Pace
- Pauses
- Breathing
- Emphasis
- Vocal Energy
- Emotional Intensity
The final delivery should communicate [EMOTION] without sounding exaggerated.
Create a natural and believable vocal performance.

title: Voz para Storytelling
chapter_title: VOZ Y DIRECCIÓN DE VOZ CON IA
purpose: Crear una interpretación que acompañe una historia y evolucione emocionalmente en lugar de mantener el mismo tono durante todo el video.
prompt:
Act as a professional storytelling voice director.
Create a dynamic voice performance for:
Story: [STORY]
Script: [SCRIPT]
Narrative Structure: [STRUCTURE]
Divide the vocal performance into emotional stages:
1. Hook
2. Introduction
3. Conflict
4. Development
5. Transformation
6. Resolution
7. CTA
For each stage define:
- Tone
- Energy
- Pace
- Emotional Intensity
- Pauses
- Key Words to Emphasize
The voice should evolve naturally throughout the story.
Avoid delivering the entire script with the same emotional tone.

title: Voz de Personaje
chapter_title: VOZ Y DIRECCIÓN DE VOZ CON IA
purpose: Crear una identidad vocal consistente para un personaje que aparecerá en diferentes videos.
prompt:
Act as a professional character voice designer.
Create a consistent vocal identity for:
Character: [CHARACTER]
Age: [AGE]
Personality: [PERSONALITY]
Background: [BACKGROUND]
Role: [ROLE]
Emotional Traits: [EMOTIONAL TRAITS]
Define the character's:
- Voice Type
- Pitch
- Vocal Texture
- Speaking Rhythm
- Accent
- Energy
- Vocabulary
- Emotional Range
- Typical Expressions
The voice must remain consistent across multiple scenes and future episodes.
Create a detailed voice identity that can be reused for this character.

title: Voz + Música + Video
chapter_title: VOZ Y DIRECCIÓN DE VOZ CON IA
purpose: Este es el prompt avanzado del capítulo. Permite coordinar voz, música y narrativa audiovisual para que los tres elementos trabajen juntos.
prompt:
Act as a professional audiovisual director, voice director and music supervisor.
Analyze the following project:
Project: [PROJECT]
Video Duration: [DURATION]
Script: [SCRIPT]
Visual Structure: [VISUAL STRUCTURE]
Music: [MUSIC DESCRIPTION]
Create an integrated audiovisual direction for:
VOICE: Define tone, pacing, emotion, pauses and emphasis.
MUSIC: Define energy, volume, emotional progression and musical transitions.
VISUALS: Define how the voice and music should interact with the visual sequence.
Create a timeline describing:
- Voice entrances
- Voice pauses
- Musical transitions
- Emotional peaks
- Visual changes
- Important emphasis points
- CTA delivery
The voice must remain intelligible above the music.
The music should support the narration without competing with it.
Create a cohesive and professionally directed audiovisual experience.

title: Crear un Prompt Profesional
purpose: Convertir una idea sencilla en un prompt completo, estructurado y profesional.
prompt:
Act as an expert AI prompt engineer and creative director.
Transform the following idea into a professional AI prompt:
IDEA: [IDEA]
OBJECTIVE: [OBJECTIVE]
Create a structured prompt that clearly defines:
- Role
- Context
- Objective
- Subject
- Action
- Environment
- Style
- Composition
- Technical specifications
- Desired result
- Restrictions
Do not add unnecessary information.
Make the prompt precise, clear and optimized for high-quality AI generation.
Return only the final prompt in English.

title: Optimizar un Prompt
purpose: Tomar un prompt que ya existe y mejorarlo sin cambiar su intención original.
prompt:
Act as a senior AI prompt engineer.
Optimize the following prompt: [ORIGINAL PROMPT]
Preserve the original creative intention.
Improve:
- Clarity
- Specificity
- Structure
- Visual description
- Context
- Technical precision
- Consistency
- Output quality
Remove ambiguity, redundancy and unnecessary instructions.
Do not change the core concept.
Return:
1. Optimized Prompt
2. Key Improvements

title: Diagnóstico de un Prompt
purpose: Identificar por qué un prompt está produciendo resultados deficientes. Este prompt es especialmente útil para aprender que un mal resultado no siempre significa que la herramienta sea mala.
prompt:
Act as an expert AI prompt auditor.
Analyze the following prompt: [PROMPT]
Identify potential problems related to:
- Ambiguous instructions
- Missing context
- Conflicting instructions
- Lack of visual detail
- Poor structure
- Missing technical specifications
- Inconsistent character or product information
- Unclear composition
- Unrealistic expectations
Explain why each problem may negatively affect the result.
Then provide an improved version of the prompt.
Return the analysis in Spanish and the final optimized prompt in English.

title: Adaptar un Prompt a Diferentes Herramientas
purpose: Convertir una misma idea creativa para diferentes modelos o plataformas de IA.
prompt:
Act as an expert AI prompt engineer specialized in multiple generative AI platforms.
Original Prompt: [ORIGINAL PROMPT]
Creative Objective: [OBJECTIVE]
Adapt this prompt for:
[PLATFORM 1]
[PLATFORM 2]
[PLATFORM 3]
Preserve the same:
- Creative concept
- Subject
- Action
- Visual style
- Mood
- Composition
- Desired result
Adapt the wording, structure and technical instructions according to the strengths and limitations of each platform.
Return one optimized prompt for each platform.
Keep all final prompts in English.

title: Convertir una Imagen en Prompt
purpose: Analizar una imagen de referencia y convertir sus características visuales en un prompt reutilizable. Ideal para ingeniería inversa visual.
prompt:
Act as a professional visual analyst, art director and AI prompt engineer.
Analyze the provided reference image.
Identify and describe:
- Main Subject
- Character Appearance
- Product
- Environment
- Composition
- Camera Angle
- Lens
- Lighting
- Color Palette
- Materials
- Textures
- Depth of Field
- Mood
- Visual Style
- Image Quality
Then create a professional image-generation prompt that recreates the visual characteristics of the reference image without copying any unnecessary elements.
The final prompt must be written in English.

title: Crear Variaciones de un Prompt
purpose: Generar diferentes versiones de una misma idea sin perder el concepto original. Esto es muy útil para campañas publicitarias donde necesitamos 10 piezas diferentes a partir de una misma idea.
prompt:
Act as a creative director and AI prompt engineer.
Original Creative Concept: [CONCEPT]
Original Prompt: [ORIGINAL PROMPT]
Create [NUMBER] different visual variations.
Maintain the same:
- Product or Character
- Brand Identity
- Core Message
- Creative Concept
Change only:
- Environment
- Composition
- Camera Angle
- Lighting
- Action
- Visual Style
Each variation should feel clearly different while remaining part of the same campaign.
Return all prompts in English.

title: Crear un Prompt desde una Referencia + Objetivo
purpose: Combinar una imagen de referencia con un objetivo comercial. Es especialmente poderoso para publicidad porque evita que la IA simplemente "copie una estética" sin entender para qué se necesita la imagen.
prompt:
Act as a senior advertising creative director and AI prompt engineer.
Reference Image: [REFERENCE IMAGE]
Advertising Objective: [OBJECTIVE]
Product: [PRODUCT]
Target Audience: [TARGET AUDIENCE]
Analyze the visual reference and create a new professional prompt inspired by its:
- Composition
- Lighting
- Camera language
- Color palette
- Visual hierarchy
- Mood
- Art direction
Adapt the concept specifically for the product and advertising objective.
Do not simply reproduce the reference.
Create an original commercial concept that preserves the desired visual language.
Return the final prompt in English.

title: Prompt Maestro / Prompt Architect
purpose: Sirve para construir un prompt profesional desde cero, tomando decisiones creativas, técnicas y estratégicas antes de escribirlo.
prompt:
Act as a senior Creative Director, Advertising Strategist, Art Director, Cinematographer and AI Prompt Engineer.
Your task is to design the most effective AI generation prompt for the following project.
PROJECT: [PROJECT]
OBJECTIVE: [OBJECTIVE]
PRODUCT OR SUBJECT: [PRODUCT OR SUBJECT]
TARGET AUDIENCE: [TARGET AUDIENCE]
CORE MESSAGE: [CORE MESSAGE]
DESIRED EMOTION: [EMOTION]
FORMAT: [FORMAT]
REFERENCE: [REFERENCE]
First, determine the creative direction.
Then define:
1. Concept
2. Subject
3. Action
4. Environment
5. Composition
6. Camera
7. Lighting
8. Color
9. Materials and textures
10. Atmosphere
11. Emotional direction
12. Technical specifications
13. Consistency requirements
14. Negative constraints
Finally, combine all relevant information into one highly detailed professional AI prompt.
Prioritize clarity, consistency, visual storytelling and commercial effectiveness.
Do not add unnecessary details.
Return:
A. Creative Direction
B. Final Professional Prompt in English
C. Recommended Variables
D. Optional Improvements
